summary: Gabled L-4 cab built 1931 on the Sanders/Mineral county line near Thompson Falls, destroyed in 1958; a 2021 hike story says the old lookout's base remains at the summit.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1958; a 2021 Sanders County Ledger hiking story says the base of the old lookout is still at the top of the peak

access.note: A 2021 Ledger hiking story describes a hike to the summit; Forest Lookouts lists the site under the Lolo National Forest

visit.trail_note: Summit hike near Thompson Falls, described in a 2021 Ledger story; the old lookout's base is at the top

evidence.supports: once called Lookout Peak; gabled L-4 cab built in 1931

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Record lists Mineral only; the Ledger and Forest Lookouts place the peak on the Sanders/Mineral county line. Record left unchanged.

sources.title: Mt. Bushnell (Lookout Peak) Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Dates (1931 build, 1958 destruction) agree across two sources. The 'base remains' claim rests on the visible teaser of a paywalled 2021 Ledger story; confirm with a recent photo or a visit report before publishing it as current. Record county 'Mineral' is kept; the sources say Sanders/Mineral line. The Montana Lookouts list page marks it 'Removed' (not cited here).
